sync.signOutDeviceOnlyBody:
Sync is off for {{modules}}, so none of it is in your account — that’s what device-only means. Signing out clears this device, and it can’t be brought back.

To keep it: cancel, turn sync on for {{modules}}, wait for it to finish, then sign out.

errors.signed-out: Your session has expired. Sign in again to carry on.
errors.backend-missing: Cloud setup for this account is incomplete, so shared features cannot run yet.
errors.permission: You do not have access to this. If somebody shared it with you, ask them to add you again.
errors.rate-limited: Too many attempts just now. Give it {{seconds}} seconds and try again — nothing was lost.
errors.server: Something broke on our side. It has been logged — try again in a moment.
errors.unknown: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.title: That did not work

search.title: Search
search.promptBody: Tasks, notes, habits, goals, journal entries, money, study, music and albums — all at once.
search.noResultsBody: Try a shorter word, or part of one.

moderation.blockedBody: Your Daykeep account has been blocked. Cloud sync and shared groups are paused.
moderation.blockedUntil: Your Daykeep account is blocked until {{date}}. Cloud sync and shared groups are paused until then.
moderation.wipedBody: Your data was removed from this phone. Anything that had synced is still on our servers and comes back if the block is lifted.
moderation.wipedUnsaved: These modules had sync switched off, so they were never uploaded and could not be recovered: {{modules}}.
moderation.wipedNothingSaved: Nothing could be uploaded before this device was cleared, so local data was not recovered.
moderation.blockBody: They won't be able to add you to a group or send you an invitation, and you won't be able to add them. You'll both stay in any group you already share — leave the group if you want out of it.
moderation.blockedEmptyBody: Blocking someone stops them adding you to shared groups or inviting you.
moderation.blockAfterReportBody: We'll review your report. You can also stop them contacting you now.
moderation.downloadFailedBody: We could not reach your data right now. Please try again, or reply to your appeal email and we will send it to you.
moderation.downloadPartial: {{count}} part of your data could not be included. Everything else has been saved.

usage.title: Usage statistics
usage.description: Share anonymous counts of which modules you open. No content, ever.
usage.consentBody: Share a daily count of which modules you opened and how many records you saved. Nothing else.
usage.consentNever: No titles, no text, no amounts, no file names — the counts contain nothing that could be turned back into what you wrote.

private.entrySubtitleNew: A PIN-locked, encrypted area of the app
private.entrySubtitleSetUp: Locked — enter your PIN to open
private.spaceSubtitle: Encrypted on this device. Locks itself when you leave.
private.setupBody: Pick what belongs in here. Everything you add is encrypted and locked behind your PIN, and hidden from the rest of the app — search, exports and notifications included.
private.suggestionNote: These are only suggestions. Turn on anything you want, whatever you answered earlier.
private.pinHint: {{count}} digits. This is separate from your app lock.
private.confirmPinHint: Just to be sure you'll remember it.
private.noRecoveryWarning: There is no way to reset this PIN. If you forget it, you lose access to everything in your private space and we cannot restore it for you.
private.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in about {{minutes}} min.
private.decoyNotice: You're in the decoy space. Anything you add here stays here.
private.vaultEmptyBody: Anything you add is encrypted on this device and never appears in your phone's gallery.
private.tooLargeBody_one: {{count}} file was over {{mb}} MB and wasn't added.
private.tooLargeBody_other: {{count}} files were over {{mb}} MB and weren't added.
private.deleteItemBody: The file and its record are erased. This can't be undone.
private.estimatedNext: Next period around {{date}}, estimated from your own history.
private.needMoreCycles: Log a few cycles and an estimate will appear here.
private.fertileWindowConsentBody: This is a calendar-based estimate from your own average cycle length — not a medical assessment, and not a reliable way to prevent or plan pregnancy. A short reminder of that will keep showing every time it appears.
private.fertileWindowDisclaimer: Estimate only, based on your average cycle length — not contraception or a fertility diagnosis.
private.watchForHint: These came up most often before a relapse.
private.intimacySubtitle: A relationship diary nobody else reads
private.intimacyNotePlaceholder: Write as much or as little as you want…
private.deleteEntryBody: It's erased for good. This can't be undone.
private.turnOffBody: Everything recorded in this module is deleted. This can't be undone.
private.removeDecoyBody: Anything saved in the decoy space becomes unreadable.
private.decoyExplainer: A second PIN that opens a separate, empty private space — for when you're asked to unlock.
private.decoyHint: Choose a PIN you'd be willing to give someone.
private.destroyHint: Erases the keys and everything inside, permanently
private.destroyBody: Every note, entry and file inside is erased, along with the keys. There is no way back.
private.moveModulesNote: These move into this space: hidden from the Hub, locked behind your PIN, and left out of search and exports. Their existing data stays in the app's normal storage, so this hides them rather than re-encrypting them.
private.hideRowHint: Removes the private space row. Long-press the version number under Settings → About to get back in.
private.hideRowBody: The private space row disappears from Settings. To get back in, long-press the version number under Settings → About. Nothing is deleted and nothing else changes — try the gesture once now, so you know it works.
private.operatorNotice: For safety and abuse investigations, Daykeep staff can access private space contents. Every access is logged. See the privacy policy.
private.sharedAlbumsSubtitle: Encrypted photo albums you share with someone
private.albumsRealSpaceOnly: Shared albums aren't available in the decoy space.
private.albumsEmptyBody: Create one and invite someone to see it. Photos are encrypted before they leave your device — Daykeep never holds the key.
private.albumsSignInTitle: Sign in to use shared albums
private.albumsSignInBody: Shared albums are synced with another person, so they need an account. Everything else in your private space stays fully local.
private.albumLockedBody: You haven't redeemed this album's key here yet. Ask whoever shared it to send it again.
private.photoTooLarge: That file is too large for a shared album.
private.quotaReached: Your shared album storage is full.
private.uploadFailed: That photo couldn't be uploaded. Try again.
private.deletePhotoBody: It's erased for everyone in the album. This can't be undone.
private.deleteAlbumBody: Every photo is erased for everyone in it, along with the activity log. This can't be undone.
private.inviteIntro: This link does everything — it adds them to the album and shares the key to unlock it. If it won't open on their device, share the code and sealed text below instead.
private.inviteLinkHint: This is what actually adds them to the album. The two parts above are what lets them open it.
private.removeMemberBody: They lose access to anything added from now on. It can't undo what they've already seen — if that matters, ask everyone else to re-share the album with a new key.
private.acceptAlbumNeedsAccount: Sign in or create an account to accept. This invitation stays valid.
private.acceptAlbumManualIntro: This invite doesn't carry the album's key. Ask whoever shared it for the code and sealed text, sent separately from this link.
private.pushInviteBody: {{name}} invited you to a shared album on Daykeep.
private.pushNewMessageBody: {{name}} sent a message in a shared album.
private.inviteInvalid: This invite link doesn't work. Ask for a new one.
private.inviteExpired: This invite has expired. Ask for a new one.
private.inviteAlreadyAccepted: This invite has already been used.
private.invitesBannerTitle_one: You have a pending album invite
private.declineInviteBody: You won't be added to this album. Whoever invited you can send a new invite later if you change your mind.
private.showEveryModuleHint: Turns off the role filter above and shows the full module list, on this device only.
private.commentLocked: This device can’t open this yet
private.commentsOff: The album owner has turned comments off
private.allowCommentsHint: Off by default. Anyone in the album can comment once this is on.
private.allowChatHint: Off by default. Opens a shared chat for everyone in the album.
private.chatSubtitle: Only the people in this album can see it
private.chatOff: The album owner has turned chat off
private.plansSubtitle: Things the two of you mean to do
private.notesSubtitle: Freeform thoughts, just for the two of you
private.notesOff: The album owner has turned notes off
private.allowNotesHint: Off by default. A freeform thoughts feed, separate from comments and chat.

checkIn.gratefulFor: What are you grateful for right now?
checkIn.lookingForwardTo: What are you looking forward to?
checkIn.needFromEachOther: Is there anything you need from each other lately?
checkIn.favoriteMoment: What's been your favorite moment this week?
checkIn.somethingNew: Anything new you'd like to try together?
checkIn.howAreWeDoing: How do you think we're doing?
checkIn.hopeFor: What do you hope for, for us?
checkIn.missed: Anything you've missed saying out loud?
checkIn.wantToRemember: Something you want to remember about today?

private.sealingHint: Your PIN never leaves this device.
private.togetherNoHubBody: Pick one of your shared albums to be your relationship hub, or start a new one.
private.togetherNoAlbumsYet: You don't have a shared album yet.
private.togetherRemoveHubTitle: Stop using this as your Together space?
private.togetherRemoveHubBody: The album itself, its photos and chat are untouched — this only turns off the Together view.
private.togetherLocked: This device hasn't redeemed this album's key yet. Ask a member to resend it from Members.
private.togetherShareCycleHint: Shares only your current cycle day and predicted next start — never symptoms, notes, or any other entry.
private.insightsSubtitle: Trends from what you already log
private.insightsEmpty: Log a few entries and trends will start showing up here.
private.cycleTrendHint: From your own logged periods — not a prediction.
private.moodTrendNeedMore: Log a few more entries to see a trend.
private.moodTrendUp: Trending up over your recent entries.
private.moodTrendDown: Trending down over your recent entries.
private.voiceNoMicBody: Allow microphone access to send a voice note.
private.voiceFailed_too-long: A voice note can be up to ten minutes long.
private.voiceFailed_too-large: That recording is too large to send.
private.voiceFailed_unreadable: The recording could not be read.
private.voiceFailed_quota: This album has run out of storage.
private.voiceFailed_failed: It could not be sent. Try again.
private.pushNewVoiceBody: {{name}} sent a voice note in a shared album.

moduleFlags.defaultMessage: This module is switched off right now. Your data is safe and will be here when it returns.

profile.title: Profile
profile.guestBody: Create an account to set a profile picture and sync across devices.
profile.removePhotoBody: Your profile picture will be deleted.
profile.photoVisibility: Your photo and name are visible to people you share expense groups with. Nothing else in Daykeep is.
profile.avatarFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.

sharing.viewerNotice: Screenshots are blocked and this can't be saved or forwarded. Your name is shown across it. Nothing stops someone photographing the screen with another device.
sharing.reportRateLimited: You've reported a lot recently. Try again later.
sharing.reportEvidenceNote: The item you’re reporting is sent with this report so it can be reviewed. Nothing else from this space is.

media.title: Photos & files
media.rowHint: Back up the files themselves, not just their details
media.needsAccount: An account is needed for this
media.needsAccountBody: Files are backed up to your account. Sign in first — everything already on this device stays exactly where it is.
media.backUpFilesHint: Uploads the files themselves so another device can open them. Off by default.
media.wifiOnlyHint: Uploading a video library over mobile data is somebody’s month.
media.quotaReached: You’ve reached your storage limit. Nothing new is being uploaded.
media.downloadedFilesHint: {{size}} of files fetched from your account onto this device.
media.clearCacheBody: This only removes files this device downloaded — anything imported here stays. They can be fetched again whenever you need them.
media.limitsNote: Your private space is never backed up. Its files are encrypted with a key that only exists on this device, so uploading them would achieve nothing.
media.alwaysFreeBody: Habits, tasks, journal, budget and everything else you write — plus your profile picture — keep syncing free, forever. Only backing up photos, video and audio is a Plus feature.
media.backUpFilesPlusOnly: Requires Plus — local use stays free either way.
media.backupUpsellTitle: Cloud backup is a Plus feature
media.backupUpsellBody: Your photos, video and audio stay fully usable on this device for free. Backing them up to the cloud — so a new phone doesn't start empty — needs a Plus plan. See the plans below.

billing.confirmBody: You’ll be taken to Safepay to complete a secure, recurring payment. You can cancel anytime from this screen.
billing.checkoutProcessing: Processing your payment — this can take a moment to confirm.
billing.chargedNote: Recurring billing through Safepay. Cancel anytime.
billing.cancelBody: Your plan stays active until the current billing period ends, then it moves to Free.
billing.cancelRequested: Cancellation requested — this can take a moment to confirm
billing.renewalBody: Confirm to keep your plan at the regular price. Nothing changes until you do.
billing.switchPlanBody: Safepay can't switch you straight from one paid plan to another. Cancel your current plan, then pick the new one once that's confirmed.
billing.insightsUpsellBody: Cycle length, recovery streaks and mood — trends over what you already log, for Plus accounts.
billing.albumLimitTitle: One shared album on the free plan
billing.albumLimitBody_one: The free plan includes {{count}} shared album. Upgrade to create more.
billing.albumLimitBody_other: The free plan includes {{count}} shared albums. Upgrade to create more.
billing.albumLimitToast: That's your free-plan album limit — upgrade to create another.
billing.memberLimitTitle: Two people on the free plan
billing.memberLimitBody_one: The free plan allows {{count}} person per shared album. Upgrade to add more.
billing.memberLimitBody_other: The free plan allows {{count}} people per shared album. Upgrade to add more.
billing.memberLimitToast: That's your free-plan member limit for this album — upgrade to add more.
billing.perkFreeAds: Ads shown in a few places
billing.perkPlusBackup: Cloud backup for photos, video and audio

transfer.includesAlbums_one: This also carries the key for {{count}} shared album, so it opens on the new phone too.
transfer.includesAlbums_other: This also carries the keys for {{count}} shared albums, so they open on the new phone too.
transfer.title: Add another device
transfer.entryHint: Open this private space on a second phone or tablet
transfer.intro: Your private notes already travel to your other devices — but only as sealed text, because the key to open them has never left this phone. This moves the key.
transfer.codeHint: Say it aloud, or type it on the other device. Do not send it in the same message as the sealed text below.
transfer.payloadHint: Message it, AirDrop it, paste it — it is sealed and worth nothing on its own.
transfer.warnBody: If the code and the sealed text travel in the same message, anyone reading that message has your private space. Separately, neither half is worth anything.
transfer.expiryNote: Generate a fresh code for each device. An old code stops working the moment you make a new one.

receive.title: Open an existing space
receive.entry: I already have a private space on another device
receive.intro: Bring the key across from the device that already has this space. Nothing is sent through our servers — you move both parts yourself.
receive.payloadPlaceholder: Paste what the other device gave you
receive.codeHint: The six groups the other device is showing.
receive.stepPin: 3 · Choose a PIN for this device
receive.pinHint: It can be different from the one on your other device — only the key underneath is shared.
receive.done: Your private space is now on this device
receive.errorCode: That code does not open this text. Check it on the other device.
receive.errorPayload: That does not look like a transfer. Copy it again from the other device.
receive.errorVersion: This transfer was made by a newer version of Daykeep. Update this device first.

operator.title: Operator console
operator.accountsSubtitle: Search any account, reported or not
operator.accountsSearchPlaceholder: Search by name, username, or email
operator.queueEmptyBody: Accounts with open reports appear here, worst first.
operator.adsEnabledSubtitle: Turns ad banners off app-wide when disabled. Plus accounts never see them either way.
operator.messagePlaceholder: What users should see when a module is off
operator.messageHint: Shown on the Hub card of a disabled module. Leaving it blank means the module simply vanishes with no explanation.
operator.disableBody: This takes the module away from every user of every device, immediately. Their data is untouched and comes back when you switch it on again.
operator.perUserNote: Per-account overrides live on the account’s own page, reached from Accounts or a report-queue row.
operator.archivedPlansNote: Archived plans stay valid for whoever is already on them, but are never offered to anyone choosing a new one.
operator.automaticRule: Set automatically by a rate-limit rule, not a person.
operator.claimOwnerBody: This makes you this app’s permanent owner — the only account that can add or remove other operators. It can only ever be done once, by whoever taps this first.
operator.claimOwnerDone: You are now this app’s owner.
operator.claimOwnerRowHint: Nobody has set this app up yet — be its owner
operator.couponPlansHint: Applies to any active plan unless restricted below
operator.couponsOwnerOnly: Only this app’s owner can manage coupons.
operator.moduleOverrideHint: Overrides the global switch for this one account only. Not shown here is whether one is already set — choosing an option below always sets or clears it fresh.
operator.operatorsSubtitle: Who can moderate, and who owns this app
operator.pricingSubtitle: Add, price and archive storage plans
operator.reasonHint: Required, at least 8 characters, and written to the audit log — same rule as viewing this account’s reports anywhere else in the console.
operator.reasonLabel: Why are you opening this account?
operator.removeOperatorBody: They immediately lose operator access. This does not affect their account otherwise.
operator.rosterOwnerOnly: Only the app’s owner can add, promote, demote or remove operators. Anyone on the roster can see who else is on it.
operator.setStatusBody: This uses the reason you entered above.
operator.rewardsEnabledSubtitle: Off hides it from every account. No data is touched.
operator.rewardsNoSeason: No season exists yet. Create one before enabling the challenge.
operator.rewardsShieldNote: Between 40% and 70% saved is the healthy band. Far below and shields are too rare to notice; far above and they are too easy to be worth protecting.
operator.rewardsFailuresNote: A module responsible for a large share of failures is probably setting people up to fail. Consider making it ineligible.
operator.rewardsRetentionCaveat: The control group counts only accounts that opted into usage analytics, so the comparison is biased. Good enough for a 2x threshold, not good enough to publish.
operator.seasonsSubtitle: Create, open, extend and configure a season
operator.seasonsEmpty: No seasons yet. Create one below — it starts closed, so nothing goes live until you say so.
operator.seasonNewHint: Created closed. Give it eligible modules and a ladder, then open it.
operator.seasonSubtitle: Everything this season is made of
operator.seasonFixNotReady: Nobody can join: it needs at least as many eligible modules as it asks people to commit to. Add them below, or use the default set.
operator.seasonFixClosed: Switched off, so nobody can join and every running streak is paused. Open it below.
operator.seasonFixUpcoming: Waiting on its start date. Bring the date forward to open it now.
operator.seasonFixEnded: Past its end date. Extend it below, or start a new season.
operator.seasonFixFull: Every place is taken. Raise the cap to let more people in.
operator.seasonSeed: Add the default modules and ladder
operator.seasonSeeded: Defaults added. Anything already set was left alone.
operator.seasonSwitchNote: This is the season's own switch, and it is not the same as the challenge switch on the previous screen. That one decides whether people can see the challenge; this one decides whether they can be in it.
operator.seasonOpenSubtitle: Off stops new joins and pauses every running streak. No progress is lost.
operator.seasonDatesNote: Leave either blank for no bound. Ending a season stops it without pausing anyone mid-streak, which closing does.
operator.seasonRulesNote: What a day has to contain to count. Changing these changes the deal for everybody already in the season, so change them rarely.
operator.seasonRequiredModulesHint: How many a person picks at the start
operator.seasonLiveWritesHint: Work logged offline doesn't count, even if the phone connects later. Only turn this on once the app version that supports it has shipped.
operator.seasonMinSecondsHint: An anti-bot floor, not an effort test
operator.seasonGraceHint: Activity this long past midnight still counts as yesterday
operator.seasonMaxEnrollmentsHint: Caps who can start, never who can finish
operator.seasonShieldsNote: A shield absorbs one missed day. The cap is what makes the last one feel like the last one.
operator.seasonShieldFloorHint: Perks may not take the interval below this
operator.seasonShieldCapHint: No shield is ever granted past this
operator.seasonMaxDemotionHint: Most days a single miss can cost
operator.seasonPickerNote: The lock exists so the picker cannot become the way out of a missed evening.
operator.seasonLockDaysHint: Days after joining before any swap
operator.seasonModulesNote: Only things that are naturally daily. A module with empty days by nature sets people up to fail for reasons that have nothing to do with discipline.
operator.seasonModulesShort_one: One more eligible module is needed before anybody can join.
operator.seasonModulesShort_other: {{count}} more eligible modules are needed before anybody can join.
operator.seasonLadderNote: Rungs are what the challenge promises. A season without them still runs, but there is nothing to climb toward.
operator.seasonDangerNote: Deleting removes the season and everything hanging off it. Once anybody has joined, close it instead — that stops it without touching a single record.
operator.seasonDeleteConfirmBody: {{name}} and its modules and ladder will be removed. This cannot be undone.
operator.seasonDeleteBlocked_one: One person has joined, so this season can only be closed.
operator.seasonDeleteBlocked_other: {{count}} people have joined, so this season can only be closed.

ads.privacyOptionsSubtitle: Change what ads may use your data for
ads.privacyOptionsFailed: Couldn't open your ad privacy choices. Check your connection and try again.
ads.watchForAdFree: Watch an ad, lose the ads
ads.watchForAdFreeHint: One short video buys you 24 hours without any.

challenge.title: Streak
challenge.notEnrolledBody: Keep a few parts of Daykeep alive every day, and climb a ladder of rewards.
challenge.signInBody: Joining a run needs an account, because the record lives on the server.
challenge.joinLead: Choose what you will keep alive every day. Pick at least {{count}}.
challenge.joinExtraBody: More effort buys more forgiveness, never faster progress — extras earn shields sooner.
challenge.lockNotice: Locked for the first {{days}} days, then two swaps a season.
challenge.todayConfirmingBody: Waiting for the server to record it.
challenge.liveOfflineBody: You were offline for {{modules}}, so it doesn't count yet. Open it again now that you're connected.
challenge.liveRuleNotice: You have to be online while you do the work. Anything logged offline doesn't count toward the day, even if you connect later.
challenge.shieldsBody: A shield absorbs one missed day. Your progress is untouched; the finish just moves a day later.
challenge.eventShieldSpent: A shield covered a missed day
challenge.eventAdminShield: A shield was granted by support
challenge.demotedBody: No shields left, so your progress fell from {{from}} to {{to}} days.
challenge.swapLead: Swaps take effect tomorrow. Today still needs what you committed to.
challenge.shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available on this device
challenge.stateNoneBody: There is no season open at the moment. When the next one starts it will show up here.
challenge.stateUpcomingSoon_one: Opens tomorrow. You can join from then.
challenge.stateUpcomingSoon_other: Opens in {{count}} days. You can join from then.
challenge.stateUpcomingOn: Opens on {{date}}. You can join from then.
challenge.stateEndedBody: It ended on {{date}}. The next season will appear here when it is announced.
challenge.stateFullBody: Every place has been taken. Runs already under way carry on as normal.
challenge.stateNotReadyBody: It is not ready to join yet. Nothing here is on your side — check back shortly.
challenge.statePausedBody: The challenge has been paused. Days do not count while it is paused, and nothing you have already earned is lost.
challenge.stateOpenUntil_one: Runs until {{date}} — one day left to join.
challenge.progressSafe: Your streak, shields and rungs are all kept exactly as they are.
challenge.reminderCost: Still to do: {{modules}}. Missing today drops you from {{from}} days to {{to}}.
challenge.reminderShielded: Still to do: {{modules}}. A shield would cover tonight — but it is your last line.
challenge.lastCallCost_one: No shields left. Tonight costs you {{count}} day.
challenge.lastCallCost_other: No shields left. Tonight costs you {{count}} days.
challenge.winBackNext_one: {{count}} day to the next rung. Today is day one.
challenge.winBackNext_other: {{count}} days to the next rung. Today is day one.
challenge.winBackPlain_one: You are on {{count}} day. Ready for the next?
challenge.winBackPlain_other: You are on {{count}} days. Ready for the next?
challenge.celebrateShield: Shield earned — one missed day is covered
challenge.celebrateSeasonEnded: Your season has ended — see how it went
